gitCommit.subject: feat: upgrade Vercel AI SDK v4 → v6 (#1378)
gitCommit.body:
feat: upgrade Vercel AI SDK v4 → v6 (#1378)

* feat: upgrade Vercel AI SDK from v4 to v6

Upgrade ai (4.3→6.0), @ai-sdk/google (1.2→2.0), @ai-sdk/openai (1.3→2.0),
@ai-sdk/react (1.2→3.0). Key changes:

- Chat API: use convertToModelMessages to bridge UIMessage (parts format)
  to ModelMessage (content format) expected by streamText v6
- Chat API: pass system prompt via streamText system parameter
- Client components: adapt to v6 UIMessage shape (parts[] instead of
  content string, dynamic-tool instead of tool-invocation)
- Tool definitions: rename args → input per v6 schema
- Gemini libs: update generateText/generateObject call signatures
- Add utils/chat/index.ts with getMessageTextContent helper

* fix: update chat system prompt tests for AI SDK v6

Adapt test to read system prompt from streamText's `system` parameter
instead of searching messages array (v6 uses dedicated system param).
Also mock `convertToModelMessages` and `toUIMessageStreamResponse`.

* fix(chat): restore createdAt when loading persisted messages

AI SDK v6 UIMessage no longer includes createdAt, so it was
dropped during the upgrade. Re-attach it from the DB payload
so ChatMessageBubble can display timestamps again.
